Torah to Musa, Injil to Isa, Quran to Muhammad (PBUH).
What is the approximate length of the Line of Control (LoC) in Kashmir?
The LoC in Kashmir is commonly cited as about 740 km long.
It is not a final international border. Note: Estimates vary slightly (about 740 to 778 km).
On which river is Mangla Dam built?
Mangla Dam is built on the Jhelum River.
It is near Mirpur, AJK, and was completed in 1967. Tarbela is on the Indus.
Bari Doab lies between which rivers?
Bari Doab lies between the Ravi and Beas rivers.
A doab is land between two rivers. Rachna Doab lies between the Ravi and Chenab. Note: Some sources define Bari Doab as between Beas/Sutlej and Ravi; standard answer used.
Al-Mu'awwidhatayn are the last two surahs, Al-Falaq (113) and An-Nas (114), used for seeking refuge.
Surah Al-Ikhlas is 112. An-Nas is the last surah of the Quran.
Which Surah was recited before Najashi by Ja'far ibn Abi Talib?
Ja'far ibn Abi Talib recited Surah Maryam before Najashi.
This was during the migration to Abyssinia. It speaks of Maryam and Isa.
Which well-known body of water is famous for its very high salinity?
The Dead Sea is famous for very high salinity; it is technically a hypersaline lake.
It lies between Jordan and Israel/West Bank and has the lowest land elevation on Earth.
Which country has the world's longest written national constitution?
India has the longest written constitution of any sovereign country.
It was adopted on 26 November 1949 and took effect on 26 January 1950.
In which year did Shah Waliullah die?
He was born in 1703. He translated the Quran into Persian.
In which mountain range is Siachen Glacier located?
Siachen Glacier lies in the eastern Karakoram.
It is among the longest glaciers outside the polar regions.
A train travels at 120 miles per hour. How far does it travel in 12 minutes?
12 minutes is 0.2 hour, so distance = 120 x 0.2 = 24 miles.
Which Surah is traditionally called the “Heart of the Quran”?
Surah Ya-Sin (Surah 36) is traditionally called the Heart of the Quran.
It has 83 verses in the Hafs numbering. The hadith wording is debated by scholars. Note: Popular title based on a hadith whose grading is debated; still the standard exam answer.
If yesterday was Monday, what day will it be the day after tomorrow?
If yesterday was Monday, today is Tuesday, so the day after tomorrow is Thursday.
Tomorrow is Wednesday. Count forward from today.
A class has 500 students, of whom 360 are boys. What percentage are girls?
Boys are 72%. Percentage = part / whole x 100.
A helicopter uses 50 gallons to travel 320 km. How much fuel is needed for 400 km at the same rate?
Fuel per km is 50/320, so 400 km needs 50 x 400/320 = 62.5 gallons.
Fuel use is assumed proportional to distance.
Amjad and Ahmed have 24 balloons in total. If Amjad has three times as many as Ahmed, how many does Amjad have?
If Ahmed has x, Amjad has 3x, so 4x = 24 and x = 6. Amjad has 18.
A train travels at 120 km/h. How far does it travel in 18 minutes?
18 minutes is 0.3 hour, so distance = 120 x 0.3 = 36 km.
Distance = speed x time. 120 km/h means 2 km per minute.
